sn14.15:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
sn14.15:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā sāriputto sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhagavato avidūre caṅkamati.
sn14.15:1.3: āyasmāpi kho mahāmoggallāno sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhagavato avidūre caṅkamati.
sn14.15:1.4: āyasmāpi kho mahākassapo sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhagavato avidūre caṅkamati.
sn14.15:1.5: āyasmāpi kho anuruddho sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhagavato avidūre caṅkamati.
sn14.15:1.6: āyasmāpi kho puṇṇo mantāniputto sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhagavato avidūre caṅkamati.
sn14.15:1.7: āyasmāpi kho upāli sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhagavato avidūre caṅkamati.
sn14.15:1.8: āyasmāpi kho ānando sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhagavato avidūre caṅkamati.
sn14.15:1.9: devadattopi kho sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhagavato avidūre caṅkamati.
sn14.15:2.2: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave, sāriputtaṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti?
sn14.15:2.4: sabbe kho ete bhikkhave, bhikkhū mahāpaññā.
sn14.15:2.5: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave, moggallānaṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti?
sn14.15:2.7: sabbe kho ete bhikkhave, bhikkhū mahiddhikā.
sn14.15:2.8: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave, kassapaṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti?
sn14.15:2.10: sabbe kho ete bhikkhave, bhikkhū dhutavādā.
sn14.15:2.11: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave, anuruddhaṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti?
sn14.15:2.13: sabbe kho ete bhikkhave, bhikkhū dibbacakkhukā.
sn14.15:2.14: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave, puṇṇaṃ mantāniputtaṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti?
sn14.15:2.16: sabbe kho ete bhikkhave, bhikkhū dhammakathikā.
sn14.15:2.17: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave, upāliṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti?
sn14.15:2.19: sabbe kho ete bhikkhave, bhikkhū vinayadharā.
sn14.15:2.20: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave, ānandaṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti?
sn14.15:2.22: sabbe kho ete bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahussutā.
sn14.15:2.23: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave, devadattaṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti?
sn14.15:2.25: sabbe kho ete bhikkhave, bhikkhū pāpicchā.
sn14.15:3.4: atītampi bhikkhave, addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu:
sn14.15:4.1: anāgatampi bhikkhave, addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandissanti samessanti:
sn14.15:5.1: etarahipi bhikkhave, paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandanti samenti:
